symbolicQueries.name: dependency-direction
symbolicQueries.cypher:
WITH $layerOrder AS layerOrder
MATCH (src:File)-[i:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(i.viaReExport, false)]->(tgt:File)
WHERE src.layer IS NOT NULL AND tgt.layer IS NOT NULL
  AND src.layer <> tgt.layer
WITH src, tgt, i,
     apoc.coll.indexOf(layerOrder, src.layer) AS srcIdx,
     apoc.coll.indexOf(layerOrder, tgt.layer) AS tgtIdx
WHERE srcIdx >= 0 AND tgtIdx >= 0 AND srcIdx < tgtIdx 
RETURN src.filePath AS source, tgt.filePath AS target, src.layer AS srcLayer, tgt.layer AS tgtLayer,
       type(i) AS relType,
       CASE type(i) WHEN 'IMPORTS' THEN 'imports' ELSE 're-exports' END AS verb,
       i.line AS line, i.lines AS lines, coalesce(i.isTypeOnly, false) AS isTypeOnly
ORDER BY source, target, relType

symbolicQueries.name: no-cyclic-deps
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH p = (f:File)-[_ev0:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS*2..10]->(f)
WHERE ALL(_evr IN _ev0 WHERE NOT coalesce(_evr.viaReExport, false)) AND ALL(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.filePath >= f.filePath)
  AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)[1..])) = length(p) 
WITH DISTINCT [n IN nodes(p) | n.filePath] AS cycle, relationships(p)[0].line AS firstLine
WITH cycle, min(firstLine) AS line
RETURN cycle, cycle[1] AS target, line
ORDER BY cycle
LIMIT 101

symbolicQueries.name: no-domain-outward-dep
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (src:File)-[i:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(i.viaReExport, false)]->(tgt:File)
WHERE src.layer = $domainLayer AND tgt.layer <> $domainLayer 
RETURN src.filePath AS source, tgt.filePath AS target, tgt.layer AS violatingLayer,
       type(i) AS relType,
       CASE type(i) WHEN 'IMPORTS' THEN 'imports' ELSE 're-exports' END AS verb,
       i.line AS line, i.lines AS lines, coalesce(i.isTypeOnly, false) AS isTypeOnly
ORDER BY source, target, relType

symbolicQueries.name: domain-purity
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (src:File)-[i:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(i.reExportHop, false)]->(p:Package)
WHERE src.layer = $domainLayer
  AND ANY(fp IN $forbiddenImports WHERE p.name = fp OR (fp ENDS WITH '/*' AND p.name STARTS WITH left(fp, size(fp) - 1))) 
RETURN src.filePath AS source, p.name AS target, type(i) AS relType,
       CASE type(i) WHEN 'IMPORTS' THEN 'imports' ELSE 're-exports' END AS verb,
       i.line AS line, i.lines AS lines, coalesce(i.isTypeOnly, false) AS isTypeOnly
ORDER BY source, target, relType

symbolicQueries.name: dependency-inversion
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)-[:CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS]->(dep)
WHERE c.layer IN $applicationLayers
WITH c, count(CASE WHEN dep:Interface THEN 1 END) AS interfaceDeps, count(dep) AS totalDeps
WHERE totalDeps > 0 
WITH c, toFloat(interfaceDeps) / totalDeps AS ratio
WHERE ratio < $threshold
RETURN c.name AS class, c.filePath AS filePath, ratio
ORDER BY filePath, class

symbolicQueries.name: repository-pattern
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)
WHERE c.layer = $infraLayer
  AND c.name =~ '.*(Repository|Repo)(Impl)?'
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(:Interface) } 
RETURN '' AS interface, c.name AS implementation, c.filePath AS filePath
ORDER BY filePath, implementation

symbolicQueries.name: use-case-isolation
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (uc:Class)
WHERE uc.layer IN $applicationLayers
  AND ANY(role IN $useCaseRoles WHERE uc.name ENDS WITH role OR uc.name ENDS WITH role + 'Impl')
WITH uc
MATCH (uc)-[:CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS]->(dep)
WHERE dep.layer IS NOT NULL AND dep.layer <> $domainLayer AND NOT dep.layer IN $applicationLayers 
WITH uc, apoc.coll.sort(collect(dep.name)) AS violations
RETURN uc.name AS useCase, uc.filePath AS filePath, violations
ORDER BY filePath, useCase

symbolicQueries.name: controller-no-entity
symbolicQueries.cypher:
CALL {
MATCH (ctrl:Class)-[_ev0:IMPORTS|CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS*1..2]->(entity:Class)
WHERE ALL(_evr IN _ev0 WHERE NOT coalesce(_evr.reExportHop, false)) AND ctrl.layer = $controllerLayer AND entity.layer = $domainLayer
  AND ANY(role IN $entityRoles WHERE entity.name ENDS WITH role OR entity.name ENDS WITH role + 'Impl') 
RETURN ctrl.name AS controller, entity.name AS entity, ctrl.filePath AS filePath
UNION
MATCH (ctrl:Class)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Method)-[u:SIGNATURE_USES]->(entity:Class)
WHERE u.publicSurface = true
  AND ctrl.layer = $controllerLayer AND entity.layer = $domainLayer
  AND ctrl.name ENDS WITH 'Controller' 
RETURN ctrl.name AS controller, entity.name AS entity, ctrl.filePath AS filePath
}
RETURN controller, entity, filePath
ORDER BY filePath, controller, entity

symbolicQueries.name: domain-state-purity
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)-[e:FLOWS_TO|CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS]->(t)
WHERE c.layer = $domainLayer AND t.layer = $infraLayer AND (t:Class OR t:Interface) 
RETURN c.filePath AS filePath, c.name AS class, t.filePath AS target, t.name AS targetName,
       type(e) AS relType, coalesce(e.field, e.parameterName) AS field, e.line AS line
ORDER BY filePath, class, target, relType, field

symbolicQueries.name: domain-stability
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)
WHERE f.layer = $domainLayer
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)<-[_ev0:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev0.viaReExport, false)]-(incoming:File) WHERE incoming.layer <> $domainLayer
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[_ev1:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev1.viaReExport, false)]->(outgoing:File) WHERE outgoing.layer <> $domainLayer
WITH f, count(DISTINCT incoming) AS fanIn, count(DISTINCT outgoing) AS fanOut
WHERE fanIn + fanOut > 0 
WITH f, toFloat(fanOut) / (fanIn + fanOut) AS instability
WHERE instability > $threshold
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, f.name AS name, instability
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: module-fan-out
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)-[_ev0:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev0.viaReExport, false)]->(dep:File)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT dep) AS fanOut
WHERE fanOut > $threshold AND NONE(ep IN $excludePatterns WHERE f.filePath =~ ep)
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, f.name AS name, fanOut
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: component-instability
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)
WHERE f.layer IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)<-[_ev0:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev0.viaReExport, false)]-(incoming:File)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[_ev1:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev1.viaReExport, false)]->(outgoing:File)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT incoming) AS fanIn, count(DISTINCT outgoing) AS fanOut
WHERE fanIn + fanOut > 0
WITH f, fanIn, fanOut, toFloat(fanOut) / (fanIn + fanOut) AS instability
WHERE instability > $threshold AND NONE(ep IN $excludePatterns WHERE f.filePath =~ ep)
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, f.layer AS layer, f.name AS name, instability
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: no-orphan-files
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)
WHERE f.layer IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (f)-[_ev0:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev0.viaReExport, false)]->(:File) }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:File)-[_ev1:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev1.viaReExport, false)]->(f) }
  AND NOT f.isBarrel 
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, f.name AS name, f.layer AS layer
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: max-fan-in
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)<-[_ev0:IMPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(_ev0.viaReExport, false)]-(incoming:File)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT incoming) AS fanIn
WHERE fanIn > $threshold 
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, f.name AS name, fanIn
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: abstraction-ratio
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (n) WHERE n:Class OR n:Interface
WITH count(CASE WHEN n:Interface THEN 1 END) AS interfaces,
     count(n) AS total
WHERE total > 0
WITH toFloat(interfaces) / total AS ratio
WHERE ratio < $threshold
RETURN '<project>' AS filePath, ratio
ORDER BY ratio

symbolicQueries.name: single-responsibility-proxy
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Method)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS]->(dep)
WITH c, count(DISTINCT m) AS methodCount, count(DISTINCT dep) AS depCount
WHERE (methodCount > $maxPublicMethods OR depCount > $maxDependencies) 
RETURN c.name AS class, c.filePath AS filePath, methodCount, depCount
ORDER BY filePath, class

symbolicQueries.name: interface-segregation-proxy
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (i:Interface)-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Method)
WITH i, count(m) AS methodCount
WHERE methodCount > $maxInterfaceMethods 
RETURN i.name AS interface, i.filePath AS filePath, methodCount
ORDER BY filePath, interface

symbolicQueries.name: inheritance-depth
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH path = (c:Class)-[:EXTENDS*]->(base:Class)
WITH c, length(path) AS depth
WHERE depth > $maxDepth 
RETURN c.name AS class, c.filePath AS filePath, depth
ORDER BY filePath, class, depth

symbolicQueries.name: naming-services
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)
WHERE c.layer IN $applicationLayers
  AND ANY(role IN ['Service', 'UseCase'] WHERE c.name CONTAINS role)
  AND NOT c.name =~ $pattern 
RETURN c.name AS class, c.filePath AS filePath
ORDER BY filePath, class

symbolicQueries.name: naming-repos
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Class)
WHERE (c.name CONTAINS 'Repository' OR c.name CONTAINS 'Repo')
  AND NOT c.name =~ $pattern 
RETURN c.name AS class, c.filePath AS filePath
ORDER BY filePath, class

symbolicQueries.name: test-file-pairing
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (src:File)
WHERE src.layer IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT src.isBarrel
  AND NOT src.filePath CONTAINS '.spec.'
  AND NOT src.filePath CONTAINS '.test.'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (test:File)
    WHERE test.filePath = replace(src.filePath, '.ts', '.spec.ts')
       OR test.filePath = replace(src.filePath, '.ts', '.test.ts')
  } AND NONE(ep IN $excludePatterns WHERE src.filePath =~ ep)
RETURN src.filePath AS filePath, src.name AS name
ORDER BY filePath

symbolicQueries.name: no-index-logic
symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (f:File)
WHERE f.isBarrel = true OR f.name IN ['index.ts', 'index.tsx']
MATCH (f)-[:DECLARES]->(decl)
WHERE NOT decl:Function OR decl.name IS NOT NULL
WITH f, count(decl) AS declCount
WHERE declCount > 0 
RETURN f.filePath AS filePath, declCount
ORDER BY filePath

semanticCriteria.rule: The module's files form one coherent unit with a consistent abstraction and boundary.

rubric.pass: The files serve one cohesive concern, use the module's abstractions consistently, and keep each rule or invariant in one place.
rubric.fail: The files split into unrelated concerns, duplicate a rule or invariant that should live in one place, or bypass the module's own abstractions.
rubric.evidenceRequired: Name each file involved and cite the declarations that show the split, the duplication or the bypass.

semanticCriteria.rule: The unit's responsibilities match the role of its declared layer.

rubric.pass: Every responsibility in the file belongs to the role and kind of its declared layer, and agrees with any ADR prose given.
rubric.fail: The file carries a responsibility that belongs to a different layer kind, for example persistence, transport or framework logic in a domain file, or business rules in an infrastructure or presentation file.
rubric.evidenceRequired: Name the file and cite the function, method or statement that carries the misplaced responsibility, and the layer kind it belongs to.

  AND ANY(role IN $entityRoles WHERE entity.name ENDS WITH role OR entity.name ENDS WITH role + 'Impl')

symbolicQueries.name: no-cyclic-deps

WITH DISTINCT [n IN nodes(p) | n.filePath] AS cycle, relationships(p)[0].line AS firstLine

RETURN cycle, cycle[1] AS target, line
ORDER BY cycle
LIMIT 101

WHERE f.filePath STARTS WITH $sourceRoot

symbolicQueries.cypher:
MATCH (src:File)-[i:IMPORTS|RE_EXPORTS WHERE NOT coalesce(i.viaReExport, false)]->(tgt:File)
WITH src, tgt, i,
     [r IN $contextRoots WHERE src.filePath STARTS WITH r] AS srcCtx,
     [r IN $contextRoots WHERE tgt.filePath STARTS WITH r] AS tgtCtx
WHERE size(srcCtx) > 0 AND size(tgtCtx) > 0 AND srcCtx[0] <> tgtCtx[0]
  AND NONE(p IN $publicApiPatterns WHERE tgt.filePath =~ p)
  AND NONE(p IN $aclPatterns WHERE src.filePath =~ p) 
RETURN src.filePath AS source, tgt.filePath AS target, srcCtx[0] AS sourceContext, tgtCtx[0] AS targetContext,
       type(i) AS relType,
       CASE type(i) WHEN 'IMPORTS' THEN 'imports' ELSE 're-exports' END AS verb,

ORDER BY source, target, relType

WHERE ANY(p IN agg.innerEntities WHERE tgt.filePath =~ p)
  AND NOT src.filePath =~ agg.module 
RETURN src.filePath AS source, tgt.filePath AS target, agg.name AS aggregate,
       type(i) AS relType,
       CASE type(i) WHEN 'IMPORTS' THEN 'imports' ELSE 're-exports' END AS verb,
       i.line AS line, i.lines AS lines, coalesce(i.isTypeOnly, false) AS isTypeOnly
ORDER BY source, target, relType

  AND ANY(p IN agg.innerEntities WHERE tgt.filePath =~ p)

WHERE ANY(p IN $valueObjectPatterns WHERE c.filePath =~ p) 
WITH c,
     [f IN coalesce(c.publicFields, [])
        WHERE NOT f IN coalesce(c.readonlyFields, []) AND NOT f IN coalesce(c.staticFields, []) | c.name + '.' + f + ' (public mutable field)']
     + [s IN coalesce(c.setAccessors, []) | c.name + '.' + s + ' (set accessor)']

WHERE size(members) > 0
RETURN c.filePath AS filePath, c.name AS class, reduce(acc = head(members), x IN tail(members) | acc + ', ' + x) AS method,
       members
ORDER BY filePath, class
